description: Models electrochemical and transport behavior in fuel cells.
body: Signature edition. Signature-original methods and framings for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Models electrochemical and transport behavior in fuel cells. A fuel-cell simulator couples electrochemistry, two-phase water transport, and heat in PEM and solid-oxide cells to predict polarization curves and durability. Real implementations include COMSOL Fuel Cell, AVL Fire, and open models. It optimizes flow fields and operating conditions.

t: Fuel-Cell Performance Simulation Tool — Teaching-ladder exercise
description: Models electrochemical and transport behavior in fuel cells.
body: Signature edition. Signature-original methods and framings for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Teaching ladder for Fuel-Cell Performance Simulation Tool, simple to complex. Rank 1: name the tool's single core action (Multiphysics MEA modeling). Rank 3: run it once on a tiny input and check the output. Rank 5: combine two capabilities: Multiphysics MEA modeling and Two-phase water management. Rank 7: chain its output into a neighboring tool (Battery electrochemical modeling software) with a verification checkpoint. Rank 9+: automate the full workflow and teach it to someone else.
